transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. We're doing our routine pre-publication check-in for the catalog. I'd like to hear from submissions and technical screening staff regarding any status or master-file issues, particularly for 'Glass Harbor,' which is listed at 94 minutes with its premiere status still marked for confirmation. Please go ahead and report what you know.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I checked the national festival database yesterday and confirmed that 'Glass Harbor' already had a public screening at the Coastline Film Week in this country. I recorded the result in my local review notes, but the database export feeding Mara's catalog review has not refreshed, so that information isn't showing up in the catalog system yet.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I completed ingest quality control this morning and confirmed that the filmmaker's approved festival cut is an 88-minute DCP, not the 94 minutes listed in the catalog draft. The QC report is waiting in the technical queue and hasn't been attached to the programming record yet.
transcript.speaker: A3

commitments.detail: Update 'Glass Harbor' runtime from 94 minutes to 88 minutes to match the approved festival cut DCP.
Update 'Glass Harbor' premiere status from 'for confirmation' to 'not a national premiere' based on the confirmed prior public screening at Coastline Film Week.
Assign 'Glass Harbor' to the panorama program, as it is not eligible for national competition due to not being a national premiere and the approved cut exceeds the 90-minute competition limit.
Attach the QC report from the technical queue to the programming record for 'Glass Harbor' to document the 88-minute approved DCP.
Refresh the database export feeding the catalog system so the premiere status reflects the Coastline Film Week screening recorded in local review notes.
